svg.title: S3-FIFO entry lifecycle
svg.desc: A miss loads the value. A key remembered by the ghost queue enters the main FIFO; other keys enter the small FIFO. Under eviction pressure, small-queue entries with at least two hits move to the main queue with their counter reset. Other small-queue entries lose their values and leave their keys in the bounded ghost queue. Main-queue entries with a positive counter are reinserted with the counter decremented; entries at zero are evicted.
